content: An isthmus is a narrow strip of land that is bordered on both sides by water and serves as a connection between two larger landmasses. It is essentially the opposite of a strait, which is a narrow body of water that lies between two landmasses and connects two larger bodies of water. Isthmuses are often ideal locations for constructing canals due to their geographical features. For example, the Panama Canal, which links the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, significantly reduces naval travel time between the east and west coasts of the Americas. Here is a list of notable isthmuses: The Auckland Isthmus connects the North Auckland Peninsula (or Northland Peninsula) to the rest of New Zealand's North Island. The Isthmus of Avalon links the densely populated Avalon Peninsula to the main part of Newfoundland. The Isthmus of Corinth connects the Peloponnese Peninsula to mainland Greece. The Isthmus of Gibraltar joins Gibraltar to mainland Spain. The Karelian Isthmus lies between the Gulf of Finland and Lake Ladoga. The Isthmus of Kra connects the Malay Peninsula to mainland Asia. The Isthmus of Kushimoto in Japan links Honshu with Cape Shiono-Misaki. La Coupée isthmus is located in Sark. The Madison Isthmus lies between Lake Mendota and Lake Monona in Madison, Wisconsin. The Mavis Grind Isthmus is situated in Shetland, UK. The Isthmus of Médanos connects Venezuela to Médanos. The Neck on Bruny Island, Tasmania, connects North Bruny and South Bruny. The Ofqui Isthmus is located in the Aysen Region of Chile. The Isthmus of Panama, arguably the most famous isthmus, connects North America and South America. The Isthmus of Perekop links Crimea to mainland Ukraine. The Isthmus of Potidea connects the Kassandra Peninsula to mainland Greece. Quezon Province in Luzon, Philippines, connects the Bicol Peninsula to mainland Luzon. Adam's Bridge, a former isthmus, once connected India and Sri Lanka. The Isthmus of Suez, located in Egypt, connects North Africa and Southwest Asia and is the site of the Suez Canal. The Isthmus of Summerside connects the western section of Prince Edward Island, Canada, to the rest of the island. The Isthmus of Tehuantepec connects the Yucatan Peninsula and Central America to the rest of Mexico. The Isthmus of Nahant connects Nahant, Massachusetts, to the mainland of Massachusetts.
